purpose: Prospective constants for the selected comparison and executable count arithmetic; not a runtime configuration framework or observed result.

dm_resolved_details.actor_objective: negative episode-average sum of log_probability times detached Monte Carlo advantage
dm_resolved_details.critic_objective: 0.5 times mean squared error over valid decision rows
dm_resolved_details.entropy_objective: negative coefficient times episode-average sum of valid decision entropies
dm_resolved_details.adam: one joint optimizer; betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0; no clipping or standardization
dm_resolved_details.initialization: paired PyTorch Linear defaults for corresponding hidden/critic weights; both residual output layers zero; G direct-b coefficient zero; T direct-b coefficient 2*log(3) and residual output bias -log(3)
dm_resolved_details.loss_mask: only actual pre-submission decision rows contribute; padded and post-submission rows do not
dm_resolved_details.service_samples: after transitions at integer states t+1 through t+8 for a submission at t
dm_resolved_details.initial_latch: a=0,e=0; read before update; CONTINUE sets a=y,e=0; COMPLETE/reset clears both
dm_resolved_details.fixed_reference_evaluation: same 1024 main evaluation episode identities as both learners; no training
dm_resolved_details.checkpoint_selection: evaluate the current model at the three specified updates; primary fixed at 128; retain final model states and all prescribed endpoint/curve/exposure records
